name: ChartView ReviewBench golden set
description: ReviewBench-inspired, repository-local regression golden set. It does not call external models or modify runtime behavior.

cases.contract: Native back/root-exit, deep links, safe-area behavior and Apps in Toss external-link handling must remain intact.
goldenFindings: Subpage back must not break platform root exit.
Major deep links and exported preview routes must remain valid.
External links must use the supported Apps in Toss bridge and must not silently fail.

cases.contract: Older cached or delayed quotes must never overwrite a newer in-session quote across Home, Watchlist, Detail and full heatmap.
goldenFindings: Reject timestamp rollback and lower-priority equal-time overwrites.
Keep structural heatmap fields when overlaying live quote fields.
Preserve cached-first rendering while still revalidating fresh data.

cases.contract: Home and full heatmap must keep canonical quote parity, two-dimensional treemap geometry, readable identity labels and expanded full-map scope.
goldenFindings: Do not regress the treemap to one-dimensional strips or leave empty board area.
Do not show stale full-heatmap values over newer Home values.
Do not collapse the full heatmap back to the compact Home universe.

cases.contract: PICK review state and technical alerts must remain advisory; sell-review must not become an automatic sell/close decision.
goldenFindings: Keep one primary review state per collapsed PICK row.
Technical sell-review signals must remain distinct from fundamental review state.
Never convert sell-review into automatic execution or completion.

cases.contract: DART, industry context and financial-quality modules must remain optional, evidence-based and non-blocking for quote/chart/detail first paint.
goldenFindings: Do not invent revenue rank, customer/supplier relationships or missing financial values.
Slow or failed DART/industry requests must not blank price, chart or unrelated sections.
Keep source period, filing basis and missing-data semantics explicit.

cases.contract: Timeout, retry, offline, progressive rendering and visible loading/recovery states must remain usable without hiding valid cached content.
goldenFindings: Partial failure must not blank unrelated valid sections.
Loading states must clear on success, empty results and failure.
Retry/offline behavior must remain visible and recoverable.
